---
title: "1,000 Pop Albums"
subtitle: "Explore cover art and metadata across 1,000 pop albums and singles from iTunes"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    toc: true
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

pop_albums <- read_csv("pop_albums.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

This catalog contains **`r nrow(pop_albums)`** distinct pop albums, EPs, and singles retrieved from the iTunes Search API. You can search by artist or album name, sort columns, or inspect album cover artwork.

## Top Artists in the Dataset

```{r}
#| label: top-artists
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 4

pop_albums |>
  count(artist, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(artist, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#3b82f6") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Artists with the Most Entries in the Catalog",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Releases"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

## Interactive Album Browser

Use the search box in the upper right to find specific artists, albums, or genres.

```{r}
#| label: album-table
#| echo: false

pop_albums |>
  mutate(
    Cover = sprintf(
      '<a href="%s" target="_blank"><img src="%s" width="48" height="48" style="border-radius: 4px; object-fit: cover;" loading="lazy" alt="Cover"/></a>',
      cover_full,
      cover_thumbnail
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    Cover,
    Artist = artist,
    Album = album,
    Year = year,
    Tracks = tracks,
    Genre = genre
  ) |>
  datatable(
    escape = FALSE,
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25,
      lengthMenu = c(10, 25, 50, 100),
      autoWidth = TRUE,
      columnDefs = list(
        list(orderable = FALSE, targets = 0),
        list(width = "60px", targets = 0)
      )
    )
  )
```
